title: Rigidity of the period map up to finite covers
summary: We first give a complete classification of bi-affine representations of mapping class groups of surfaces with finitely many boundary components or punctures. We also show that every linear representation of the mapping class group of a genus-$g$ surface with two boundary components of dimension at most $3g-3$ is bi-affine. We then classify low-dimensional symplectic representations of the mapping class group associated to triple covers.
